snippet.title: TETRIC Trailer Steam NextFest
snippet.description:
T È T R I C Steam Next Fest Reveal Trailer

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5194510/TETRIC/?beta=1

Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in T É T R I C. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.
